headline: Circle Reports Third-Quarter Earnings and Revenue Beat on USDC Growth
summary: Circle posted net income from continuing operations of $226 million, representing a 5% year-over-year increase, driven by rising USDC transaction volume.
why: Circle is a major issuer of stablecoins, specifically USDC, serving as a critical infrastructure provider bridging traditional fiat currencies and digital assets.

impacts.name: Circle
impacts.why: Stronger financial results directly reflect higher net income and growing transaction volumes.
